title: [Shopify] Limit webhook subscription payload fields
summary: Shopify webhook subscriptions now request only the required fields (id for orders, admin_graphql_api_id and type for bulk operations) instead of receiving full webhook resources, reducing payload size and network overhead.
key_points: Added topic-specific includeFields parameters to webhook subscription GraphQL queries
Orders/create webhooks now request only the id field
Bulk operations finish webhooks now request admin_graphql_api_id and type fields
Existing subscriptions are not affected; changes apply to new or recreated subscriptions
No schema, permission, or upgrade changes required
